mode.create_better_wrench.connect.desc:
[RMB] Pick a start, corner and end point; the drivetrain is built for you
[Ctrl+Scroll] Switch how corner nodes are built {Gearbox/Large Cogwheel}
mode.create_better_wrench.deconstruct.de:
[RMB] Select an area; remove everything a wrench can remove
[Ctrl+Scroll] Switch the filter {All/Create only/Redstone only}
mode.create_better_wrench.assemble.desc:
[RMB] Lock a depot to process whatever sits on it
With several items, the extras wait nearby as unpickable drops
[Ctrl+Scroll] Adjust how long the product stays
